titles.title: Original Resolution Calling on the United States Government to Help Bring Peace to Sudan
Original Resolution Calling on the United States Government to Help Bring Peace to Sudan
Calling on the United States government to be more involved in bringing peace to Sudan.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

bill.summary: This resolution calls on the United States to hold constituent states of the Quad (Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Egypt, and the United States) accountable in their commitment to ending military support to Sudan.
